content.text: /ext:medcp Did prescription rates of systemic immunosuppressants decline in 2020 compared with 2019?
I'll check the clinical records database to compare systemic immunosuppressant prescription rates between 2019 and 2020.
This is an OMOP CDM database. I'll identify systemic immunosuppressants using the drug ontology (ATC class L04 — immunosuppressants), then count patients with prescriptions in each year.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, concept_code, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE vocabulary_id = 'ATC' AND concept_code = 'L04'

content.text: I have the ATC L04 immunosuppressants class (concept_id 21603890). Now I'll find all descendant drug concepts and count distinct patients with drug exposures in 2019 vs 2020.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS rx_year,
  COUNT(*) AS n_exposures,
  COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 21603890
)
AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de.drug_exposure_start_date) IN (2019, 2020)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de.drug_exposure_start_date)
ORDER BY rx_year

content.text: This is SQL Server, so I'll use `YEAR()` instead of `EXTRACT`.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
  YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS rx_year,
  COUNT(*) AS n_exposures,
  COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 21603890
)
AND YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date) IN (2019, 2020)
GROUP BY YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date)
ORDER BY rx_year

content.text:
No — prescription rates rose in 2020, they did not decline.

Systemic immunosuppressants (ATC L04 and all descendant drug concepts), by drug exposure start date:

| Year | Prescriptions (exposures) | Distinct patients |
|------|--------------------------:|------------------:|
| 2019 | 243,677 | 12,602 |
| 2020 | 272,184 | 13,627 |

Both went up in 2020: exposures +11.7% and treated patients +8.1% vs 2019.

Caveats:
- These are raw counts, not a true "rate." A prescription *rate* would need a denominator (e.g. per enrolled/active patient); if the active population grew, the per-capita rate could differ from these totals. I can compute a denominator-normalized rate from `observation_period` if you'd like.
- Counts are by `drug_exposure_start_date`; "systemic" here is approximated by the whole L04 class (topical/local immunosuppressant formulations, if coded, are not excluded).
